summary: Balancer liquidity pools and vaults, whose liquidity-provider fee income is part of DeFi yield infrastructure, are subject to a DAO-approved phased wind-down under BIP-928. Approval occurred September 29, 2026; withdrawals-only for applicable pools is scheduled October 30 with v3 extension cases until November 30.
what_happened: BIP-928 passed on September 29, approving a voluntary shutdown plan following the earlier Balancer Labs corporate wind-down. On October 30 pausable pools move to withdrawals-only and bug bounty coverage ends; requested qualifying v3 pools may continue until November 30. Withdrawals via smart contracts remain available, and certain non-pausable pools may keep running with fee changes. These future actions are not recorded as already executed as of October 16.
uncertainty_notes: Exact pool-by-pool pauses, LP exits, withdrawal completions, and treasury disbursements cannot be inferred from the governance vote. BIP-928 approval and future execution dates are distinct facts.
notes: CYA scope is liquidity-provider/pool yield and vault wind-down; the DEX identity and trading market lifecycle are recorded independently in HEI.
